Due to hygiene reasons this product is excluded from our 30 Day Money Back Guarantee (your statutory rights are not affected).

Moulded disposable respirators with exhalation valve for low breathing resistance. Features include adjustable nose bridge, four-point strap system, comfort foam padding, and latex/metal-free design. Lightweight at 22g with 360° foamed lining for comfort, achieving a 99.7% face fit test result. Supplied in a box of 10 FFP3 moulded dust masks for cleanliness and steady supply.
